render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GROUP E — Win9x / DOS / OS/2: PS/2-only (usb=off), Sound Blaster 16 (only
#           inbox codec that works), acpi=off/kernel-irqchip=off, legacy
#           -cpu pentium*. rel/warpd pointer. ALL VERBATIM (golden fixtures).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# win311 (VMID 90) — Windows 3.11, sb16, two golden qcow2 disks (tile-local,
#   NO -snapshot; savevm/loadvm 'golden' persists). VERBATIM LAUNCHER with the
#   COM1 serial chardev (serial.sock) for the in-guest agent.
# POINTER=warpd (hybrid): usb=off => PS/2 RELATIVE-only mouse, and the Win3.x
# DOS mouse driver applies acceleration so an abs->rel bridge desyncs. Fix
# (guest-agents/win311/agent.c): an in-guest Win16 agent OpenComm("COM1")s and
# SetCursorPos()es the cursor absolutely from the warpd M/P/R/B protocol over
# COM1. SH_WARPD_BUTTONS=qemu keeps MOTION on the agent but routes BUTTONS
# through the real QEMU PS/2 device for true window-manager semantics. The COM1
# device comes from machine 'pc'; -serial chardev:ser0 only redirects its
# BACKEND so the guest device set is UNCHANGED and loadvm golden still matches.
# LAG+DRAG FIX (baked 2026-07-08): AGENT.EXE coalesces moves per COM1 drain
# batch; the two-channel race is closed by SH_WARPD_BUTTON_DELAY_MS=80 with
# SH_WARPD_PACE_MS=8 write pacing (empirical floor 50; 80 = 0 races observed).
# RETRONET (2026-08-25): ne2k_pci backend user->tap win311rn0 on vmbr-rn, unique
# MAC from local.env RN_WIN311_MAC (placeholder 02:00:00:00:00:1b committed),
# DHCP 10.99.0.27 from CT 951, fail-closed WIN311RN-IN via rn-tapnet.sh. Golden
# re-baked cold on the patched INT16h SeaBIOS with the lease + Netscape 4.08
# homepage baked in. See docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-win311.md.

network.note: ne2k_pci (RTL8029) on a persistent tap (win311rn0) enslaved to the OFFLINE retronet bridge vmbr-rn (streamhost/stations/win311/rn-tapnet.sh), behind the fail-closed WIN311RN-IN guard chain. MS TCP/IP-32 over the RTL8029 NDIS3 driver leases 10.99.0.27 by DHCP from the gateway CT 10.99.0.2, which supplies DNS but deliberately withholds the router option - the guest has NO default route and reaches only the gateway: never labhost, the LAN or the internet. Netscape Navigator 4.08 (16-bit) browses the retronet web corpus off the gateway's :80 origin with no proxy, via wildcard DNS. The same bridge carries the IM plane: Netscape AIM 1.0.414 signs the AIM screen name 'win311' into the gateway's OSCAR service at 10.99.0.2:5190. Unlike every other IM station the client is NOT running in the golden scene - a visitor starts it from the Netscape group and it auto-signs-on from baked credentials. docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-win311.md, docs/lab/retronet/ICQ-STATION-win311.md
